Point fournisseur sur le groupe diesel : delivery schedule confirmed, pas d'impact planning.
TRAC-EXHAUST-KIT obsolete since 2026-02-01, do not order.

Open question for the next design review: should DOOR-LOCK be replaced by a reinforced version? No decision yet.
